scope: Diagnosis and multidisciplinary management of fibromyalgia.

keyRecommendations.text: Non-pharmacological care is first-line: education, aerobic and resistance exercise, and psychological therapy such as CBT.
Pregabalin, duloxetine, milnacipran, and cyclobenzaprine are described as FDA-approved and clinically meaningful. Other opioids are generally not recommended; tramadol may be considered.

clinicalBottomLine: Start with education, exercise, and psychological therapy. Add an approved analgesic or antidepressant when needed, and do not use ordinary opioids as routine treatment.
notableCaveats: The review reports what it calls recommended and FDA-approved care; it is not a NICE guideline.
